macros.name: DFNallowcbreak
macros.doc: \DFNallowcbreak allows a footnote is broken into two columns, while \DFNinhibitcbreak inhibits it.

macros.name: DFNcolumnwidth
macros.doc: \DFNcolumnwidth is the width of a footnote column.

macros.name: DFNinhibitcbreak
macros.doc: \DFNallowcbreak allows a footnote is broken into two columns, while \DFNinhibitcbreak inhibits it.
